question.text: A correlation coefficient of 0 between two asset classes indicates:

answer.text: They always move in opposite directions
They always move in the same direction
No linear relationship between their movements
They have the same standard deviation

explanation.text: The Logic: A correlation of 0 means there is no linear relationship between the two assets' movements. The Trap: Always-opposite or always-same movement requires correlations of -1 or +1, not 0. Note: Correlation describes co-movement, not the magnitudes of the individual standard deviations.
